points.title: 童年与求学
points.description: 老舍出生于北京一个满族贫苦家庭，原名舒庆春。父亲早逝，家境贫寒，依靠母亲做针线活维持生计。他先后在北京师范学校附属小学和北京师范学校接受教育，这段经历使他深刻了解了底层人民的生活状况，为他后来的创作奠定了基础。在北京的童年和少年时期，他接触了丰富的北京方言和民间文化，这些元素后来成为他作品的重要特色。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a poor Manchu family in Beijing, Shu Qingchun (Lao She) lost his father at a young age and relied on his mother's needlework to survive. He received education at Beijing Normal School Affiliated Primary School and Beijing Normal School, where he gained firsthand knowledge of the living conditions of the lower classes, which later became a foundation for his writings. His childhood and youth in Beijing exposed him to rich local dialects and folk culture, elements that would become distinctive features of his literary works.

points.title: 海外求学
points.description: 1924年，老舍赴英国伦敦大学东方学院担任汉语讲师。在英国期间，他广泛阅读西方文学作品，深受狄更斯等作家的影响。这段经历开阔了他的国际视野，也使他更加反思中国传统文化与社会问题。他在伦敦完成了早期重要作品《老张的哲学》和《赵子曰》，这些作品开始展现他对中国社会问题的关注和批判精神。海外生活也让他更加怀念祖国，加深了他对民族命运的思考。
points.descriptionEn: In 1924, Lao She went to the UK to serve as a Chinese lecturer at the School of Oriental Studies, University of London. During his time in Britain, he extensively read Western literary works and was deeply influenced by writers like Charles Dickens. This experience broadened his international perspective and led him to reflect more deeply on traditional Chinese culture and social issues. In London, he completed his early important works 'Old Zhang's Philosophy' and 'Mr. Zhao Says', which began to show his concern and critical spirit towards Chinese social problems. His life abroad also made him more nostalgic for his homeland, deepening his thoughts on the nation's destiny.

points.title: 创作高峰
points.description: 1930年，老舍回到中国，先后在齐鲁大学和山东大学任教。这一时期是他创作的黄金时代，完成了代表作《骆驼祥子》。这部小说通过描写人力车夫祥子的悲惨命运，深刻揭示了旧中国社会的黑暗与不公。同时，他还创作了《离婚》、《月牙儿》等作品，展现了他在现实主义创作上的成就。在济南的生活使他更加关注普通人的命运，作品风格也更加成熟，语言运用更加精炼，形成了独特的'京味儿'文学风格。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to China in 1930, Lao She taught at Cheeloo University and Shandong University. This period marked his golden age of creation, during which he completed his masterpiece 'Rickshaw Boy'. This novel profoundly reveals the darkness and injustice of old Chinese society through depicting the tragic fate of rickshaw puller Xiangzi. He also wrote works like 'Divorce' and 'The Crescent Moon', demonstrating his achievements in realistic writing. His life in Jinan made him more concerned about the fate of ordinary people, and his works became more mature in style with more refined language use, forming a unique 'Beijing flavor' literary style.

points.title: 抗战岁月
points.description: 抗日战争爆发后，老舍前往重庆，积极参与抗日救亡运动。他担任中华全国文艺界抗敌协会总务部主任，组织文艺工作者开展抗日宣传活动。这一时期，他创作了《四世同堂》等反映抗战生活的作品，同时也创作了大量话剧和曲艺作品，如《残雾》、《国家至上》等，为抗战文艺做出了重要贡献。在重庆的艰苦岁月中，他的创作更加关注民族命运，作品主题更加宏大，艺术表现也更加多样化，展现了一位爱国知识分子的责任担当。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, Lao She went to Chongqing and actively participated in the anti-Japanese national salvation movement. He served as Director of the General Affairs Department of the All-China Association of Literary and Art Workers for Resistance to the Enemy, organizing literary and art workers to carry out anti-Japanese propaganda activities. During this period, he created works like 'Four Generations Under One Roof' that reflected wartime life, as well as numerous plays and performing arts works such as 'Remaining Mist' and 'Supreme National Interest', making significant contributions to wartime literature. In the difficult years in Chongqing, his works focused more on the nation's destiny with broader themes and more diverse artistic expressions, demonstrating the responsibility and commitment of a patriotic intellectual.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 新中国成立后，老舍回到北京，担任中国文联副主席、中国作协副主席等职。他积极投身社会主义文艺建设，创作了《茶馆》、《龙须沟》等反映新社会面貌的作品。1957年，他创作了话剧《茶馆》，这部作品通过一个小茶馆的兴衰，展现了近半个世纪中国社会的历史变迁，成为中国现代话剧的经典之作。然而，在文化大革命期间，老舍遭受迫害，于1968年投太平湖自尽。他的悲剧性结局反映了那个特殊历史时期知识分子的命运，也使他的作品具有了更深沉的历史意义。
points.descriptionEn: After the founding of New China, Lao She returned to Beijing and served as Vice Chairman of the Chinese Federation of Literary and Art Circles and Vice Chairman of the Chinese Writers Association. He actively devoted himself to the construction of socialist literature and art, creating works like 'Teahouse' and 'Dragon Beard Ditch' that reflected the new face of society. In 1957, he wrote the play 'Teahouse', which, through the rise and fall of a small teahouse, showcases the historical changes in Chinese society over nearly half a century, becoming a classic of modern Chinese drama. However, during the Cultural Revolution, Lao She was persecuted and committed suicide by drowning in Taiping Lake in 1968. His tragic ending reflects the fate of intellectuals during that special historical period, giving his works deeper historical significance.

supporter.zh: 老舍被誉为'人民艺术家'，他的作品真实反映了普通人的生活命运，具有深厚的人文关怀。他擅长运用北京方言，创造了独特的'京味儿'文学风格，对中国现代文学做出了卓越贡献。他的代表作《骆驼祥子》、《茶馆》等已成为中国文学的经典之作，影响深远。老舍不仅是一位杰出的作家，也是一位爱国知识分子，在抗战时期积极投身救亡运动，展现了知识分子的社会责任感。
supporter.en: Lao She is hailed as 'People's Artist' for his works that truthfully reflect the lives and destinies of ordinary people, demonstrating deep humanistic care. He excelled in using Beijing dialect, creating a unique 'Beijing flavor' literary style, making outstanding contributions to modern Chinese literature. His masterpieces like 'Rickshaw Boy' and 'Teahouse' have become classics of Chinese literature with far-reaching influence. Not only was he an outstanding writer, but also a patriotic intellectual who actively participated in the national salvation movement during the war, demonstrating the social responsibility of intellectuals.

critic.zh: 批评者认为老舍的创作存在一定的局限性，特别是在新中国成立后的作品中，对政治的迎合使其艺术性有所下降。他的作品多聚焦于城市小人物，对农村题材涉及较少，视野相对狭窄。此外，老舍在文革中的悲剧结局也引发了对知识分子独立性的思考，有人认为他在政治压力下缺乏足够的勇气和坚持。他的作品虽然语言生动，但在思想深度和艺术创新方面，与同时代的一些作家相比仍有差距。
critic.en: Critics argue that Lao She's works had certain limitations, especially in his post-1949 creations where his accommodation to politics diminished their artistic value. His works primarily focused on urban minor characters with less engagement with rural themes, showing relatively narrow perspective. Furthermore, his tragic end during the Cultural Revolution has sparked reflections on intellectual independence, with some suggesting he lacked sufficient courage and perseverance under political pressure. While his language is vivid, in terms of ideological depth and artistic innovation, there are gaps compared to some contemporary writers.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，老舍被定位为中国现代文学的重要代表人物之一。他的作品不仅具有文学价值，也是研究20世纪中国社会变迁的重要史料。老舍的悲剧命运使他成为那个特殊历史时期的象征性人物，引发了人们对知识分子与政治权力关系的思考。他的作品被多次改编成电影、话剧等形式，持续影响着当代中国文化。老舍的文学成就和人生经历共同构成了中国现代文化史上的重要篇章，他的'京味儿'文学风格也成为中国地域文学的重要代表。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Lao She is recognized as one of the important representatives of modern Chinese literature. His works not only possess literary value but also serve as important historical materials for studying the social changes in 20th-century China. Lao She's tragic fate has made him a symbolic figure of that special historical period, sparking reflections on the relationship between intellectuals and political power. His works have been adapted into films, plays, and other forms, continuing to influence contemporary Chinese culture. Lao She's literary achievements and life experiences together constitute an important chapter in the history of modern Chinese culture, and his 'Beijing flavor' literary style has become a significant representative of regional Chinese literature.

self.zh: 生命是种义务，幸而尚有艺术可以安慰我们。
self.en: Life is a duty, fortunately art can comfort us.

others.zh: 老舍的作品是中国现代文学的一座丰碑，他用北京方言描绘了普通人的命运，展现了中国社会的变迁。
others.en: Lao She's works are a monument of modern Chinese literature. He used Beijing dialect to depict the fate of ordinary people and showcase the changes in Chinese society.
